digest.en: Iranian Sisters, Aged 20, Tried In High-Profile Case Tied To January Protests dominate the headlines, with Russia's 'Axis Of Upheaval' being built to last beyond Ukraine, according to analyst Kendall-Taylor. Meanwhile, a surge in organised crime in Amazon communities has local authorities concerned. ICICI Bank's $1 billion debt pricing also made headlines.
digest.hi: असम में बाढ़ का कहर जारी है, 14 और मौतों के साथ मृतकों की संख्या 61 पहुंच गई है, और सात लाख से अधिक लोग प्रभावित हैं। इस बीच, प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने एक नए वीडियो संदेश में युवाओं से कहा है कि वे बाढ़ प्रभावित क्षेत्रों में मदद के लिए आगे आएं।

articles.title: Iranian Sisters, Aged 20, Tried In High-Profile Case Tied To January Protests
articles.summary: Sixteen people are facing charges connected to protests in Isfahan in January, during which a colonel in Iran's Revolutionary Guard was killed. Rights defenders are raising concerns about the legitimacy of the case, including the charges against 20-year-old sisters Taraneh and Romina Rahimi. Iranian Sisters, Aged 20, Tried In High-Profile Case Tied To January Protests.

articles.title: Indian seafarer killed in attack on ship in Black Sea
articles.summary: The External Affairs Ministry said MV Omorfi was attacked while transiting the Black Sea, reportedly in Russian territorial waters; at the time of the incident, there were 10 crew members on board, including three Indians Indian seafarer killed in attack on ship in Black Sea.

articles.title: Russia's 'Axis Of Upheaval' Is Built To Last Beyond Ukraine, Analyst Kendall-Taylor Says
articles.summary: Russia's deepening partnerships with China, Iran, and North Korea represent one of the most significant geopolitical realignments driven by the war in Ukraine. Yet according to Andrea Kendall-Taylor, viewing this grouping through the lens of a traditional military alliance misses the bigger picture. Russia's 'Axis Of Upheaval' Is Built To Last Beyond Ukraine, Analyst Kendall-Taylor Says.

articles.title: Israeli military kills four Palestinians after settler killed in West Bank
articles.summary: Two other Israelis and four more Palestinians were wounded, health officials said, and the Israeli military announced it was preparing for an “extensive” counterterror operation in the West Bank, with troops surrounding the town of Nablus Israeli military kills four Palestinians after settler killed in West Bank.

articles.title: ICICI Bank prices $1 billion debt at tighter spread
articles.summary: The bank set the ​coupon at 100 basis points over U. S. Treasuries, sharply ⁠lower the initial guidance of 130 basis points, for its first dollar debt sale in nearly nine years. The coupon works out to be ‌5.46%. ICICI Bank prices $1 billion debt at tighter spread.

articles.title: Guyanese authorities confirm death of 72 people in sinking of coastal ferry
articles.summary: Guyanese authorities confirm 72 deaths after a state ferry capsized off the coast, leaving 179 people aboard. Of the estimated 179 people aboard, 76 were rescued as efforts continue to salvage the ship and recover all bodiesThe confirmed death toll from the recent capsizing of a state ferry off Guyana’s coast has risen to 72, with more bodies recovered as a multinational team struggle to salvage the partially submerged vessel. Of the estimated 179 people aboard, 76 people were rescued.

articles.title: ‘Women do not stop giving birth in an emergency’ – one month after Venezuela quakes
articles.summary: One month after twin earthquakes rocked Venezuela, thousands of women and girls continue to face difficulty in accessing essential healthcare and protection services, a senior official with the UN reproductive and sexual health agency UNFPA said on Friday. ‘Women do not stop giving birth in an emergency’ – one month after Venezuela quakes.

articles.title: After an Ebola centre was attacked, peacekeepers moved in next door
articles.summary: A new mobile UN peacekeeping base in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has allowed local authorities to continue responding to the fast-moving Ebola outbreak there after violence disrupted the work of medics at a treatment centre set up to contain the spread. After an Ebola centre was attacked, peacekeepers moved in next door.

articles.title: In El Obeid, Sudanese women face drones by day, rape by night, to reach water
articles.summary: In El Obeid, women and girls now face an impossible choice over something as basic as a bucket of water: risk a drone strike by collecting it in daylight, or risk rape by waiting until dark. In El Obeid, Sudanese women face drones by day, rape by night, to reach water.

articles.title: Masked men invading and taking Amazon communities ‘hostage’ in organised crime surge, say local
articles.summary: Delegation sent to Brasília after gunmen from organised crime group enter homes in western Amazon ForestIndigenous leaders on the Brazil-Peru border say their communities are being “taken hostage” by organised crime groups who are running rampant across the region, destroying Amazon Forest, building roads and trafficking drugs. articles.title: Ukraine Hits More Wildberries Warehouses Near St. Petersburg, Occupied Crimea
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones struck Wildberries logistics hubs near St. Petersburg and in occupied Crimea, causing fires and disruptions. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine also hit a key military facility in Russia’s Kirov region that supplies components for aircraft and missile systems. Ukraine Hits More Wildberries Warehouses Near St. Petersburg, Occupied Crimea.

articles.title: Wildberries, 'Russia's Amazon,' Hit Again In New Wave Of Ukrainian Strikes
articles.summary: Ukraine struck targets in several parts of Russia early on July 24, including another warehouse of Russian e-commerce retailer Wildberries, as Kyiv continues to expand its retaliatory long-range strike campaign in an effort to force Moscow into negotiations. Wildberries, 'Russia's Amazon,' Hit Again In New Wave Of Ukrainian Strikes.

articles.summary: Coverage of the conflict between Iran, Israel and the United States has largely focused on battlefield developments, political statements and international diplomacy. articles.title: Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Red Sea
articles.summary: Islamabad has condemned attacks by Iran-backed Houthi rebels on Saudi-flagged vessels in the Red Sea. It also warned that any aggressive actions toward Pakistan-flagged vessels or the country's maritime interests would be regarded as a “grave threat” that may result in “lawful use of force.” Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Read Sea. Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Red Sea.

articles.title: On The Front Line Of Ukraine's Drone War Over Kramatorsk
articles.summary: Ukrainian drone-interceptor crews are working around the clock to stop Russian reconnaissance and attack drones approaching the frontline city of Kramatorsk. RFE/RL spent a night with one team defending the skies as aerial attacks intensify. On The Front Line Of Ukraine's Drone War Over Kramatorsk.

articles.title: Iran urged to stop protest-related executions
articles.summary: Independent UN human rights investigators on Thursday called for Iran to immediately halt the execution of 10 men who took part in a protest in the central city of Isfahan earlier this year, warning that some of their relatives have already been called for final visits. Iran urged to stop protest-related executions.

articles.title: Gaza’s food gains could unravel without sustained aid, UN warns
articles.summary: Food security and child nutrition have improved across the Gaza Strip largely due to a scale-up in humanitarian assistance and commercial traffic, but progress remains fragile and could quickly reverse without sustained access, funding and recovery support. Gaza’s food gains could unravel without sustained aid, UN warns.

articles.title: Stranded seafarers remain trapped as Hormuz shipping stalls
articles.summary: As the Iran-US war continues, the key question remains unanswered about how shipping through the Strait of Hormuz will be managed in future – although the UN has reiterated that charging tolls for safe passage runs contrary to international law. Stranded seafarers remain trapped as Hormuz shipping stalls.

articles.title: No Breakthroughs, Little Optimism As Rubio, Lavrov Meet On Ukraine War
articles.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said following talks with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov that the United States remains prepared to help broker an end to Russia's war in Ukraine but that fresh proposals would be needed after previous peace ideas failed. No Breakthroughs, Little Optimism As Rubio, Lavrov Meet On Ukraine War.

articles.title: Hasina’s return from India would imperil Bangladesh’s sovereignty
articles.summary: To say Bangladesh’s former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina left office in disgrace would be an understatement by any political measure. articles.title: Countless Ukrainians Need Prosthetics. Homegrown Start-Ups Are Supplying Them
articles.summary: As battlefield injuries mount from a long-running war, Ukrainian companies are racing to meet a high demand for prosthetic limbs. One start-up, Allbionics, is making sophisticated prosthetics that it offers to patients at no cost, with the help of government support and private donations. Countless Ukrainians Need Prosthetics. Homegrown Start-Ups Are Supplying Them.

articles.title: The real reasons behind Zelensky’s unpopular military purge
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky recently made the controversial decision to dismiss Mykhailo Fedorov, his minister of defense. Fedorov, admired both by Ukrainian troops and Western allies, was at the forefront of Ukraine’s increasing technological innovations in the war against Russia. articles.title: Indonesia shouldn’t bet its nickel future on China’s EVs alone
articles.summary: Indonesia is building a battery industry and an EV ecosystem as part of its broader nickel downstreaming agenda. The objective is that downstreaming should not stop at smelters. It must move deeper into industrial components, machinery, batteries and, eventually, electric vehicles. Indonesia’s largest battery industrial hub reflects this ambition. articles.title: Iran Executes Man Charged Over January Protests As Death Row Inmates Stage Hunger Strike
articles.summary: Iran has executed Mehdi Khaneki, a young man convicted on charges tied to anti-government protests that swept across the country in January. The execution came as some 1,500 death row inmates at the prison continued a hunger strike demanding an end to executions. Iran Executes Man Charged Over January Protests As Death Row Inmates Stage Hunger Strike.

articles.title: क्या CJP का प्रदर्शन बना वांटेड अपराधियों का नया ठिकाना? वहां पहुंचे 216 में से हुई 215 की पहचान

articles.summary: केंद्र सरकार ने दिल्ली में स्टूडेंट प्रोटेस्ट को देखते हुए सुरक्षा कदम उठाए हैं। सरकार ने छत्तीसगढ़ से दिल्ली तक केंद्रीय रिजर्व पुलिस फोर्स की 10 और कंपनियों को एयरलिफ्ट का निर्देश जारी किया है। सीआईएफ ने भी दिल्ली मेट्रो सुरक्षा यूनिट के कर्मियों की छुट्टी रद्द कर दी है। केंद्र सरकार ने दिल्ली में जारी स्टूडेंट प्रोटेस्ट कोलेकर अहम सुरक्षा कदम उठाए हैं.

articles.title: भारत पर 200% टैरिफ लगाकर उल्टा फंस जाएंगे ट्रंप, तड़प उठेगा अमेरिका!
articles.summary: अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप ने सोशल मीडिया पर ऐलान किया है कि अमेरिका आने वाली जेनेरिक दवाओं पर 2 साल बाद पहले 100% और फिर 200% का भारी-भरकम टैरिफ लगाया जाएगा. ट्रंप का ये निशाना सीधे तौर पर भारत पर है, क्योंकि अमेरिका अपनी जरूरत की आधी दवाएं भारत से ही खरीदता है. हालांकि, जानकारों का मानना है कि ट्रंप का ये दांव अमेरिका पर ही भारी पड़ जाएगा, क्योंकि रातों-रात वहां नई फैक्टरियां लगाना नामुमकि।

articles.summary: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने कैबिनेट की बैठक में छात्रों के साथ जुड़ने और उनसे कनेक्शन बनाने के लिए सलाह दी है। उन्होंने मंत्रियों को सलाह दी है कि वे इंस्टाग्राम पर एक्टिव रहें और रील्स बनाकर पोस्ट करें। राष्ट्रीय राजधानी दिल्ली में नीट परीक्षा पेपर लीक के विरोध में जंतर मंतर पर जारी प्रदर्शन के बीच प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने शुक्रवार (24 जुलाई, 2026) को कैबिनेट की बैठक बुलाई.

articles.title: CJP की ताकत देर से समझी सरकार? फास्ट ट्रैक कोर्ट, नया बिल और बातचीत, महज 36 घंटे में उठाए क्या-क्या
articles.summary: केंद्र सरकार ने नीट पेपर लीक विरोध प्रदर्शन के बाद ताबड़तोड़ फैसले लिए। लोकसभा में नेता प्रतिपक्ष ने पीएम के साथ बातचीत की, जिसके बाद फास्ट ट्रैक कोर्ट की स्थापना और नया बिल पारित हुआ। सरकार ने 36 घंटे में कई महत्वपूर्ण निर्णय लिए। नीट पेपर लीक के विरोध प्रदर्शन की जो चिंगारी 30 दिन पहले सुलगी थी वो अब देश के शिक्षा तंत्र के खिलाफ एक बड़े आंदोलन का रूप ले लिया है.

articles.title: लॉन्च होते ही रॉकेट से टकराई बिजली, फिर जो हुआ, देखकर फटी रह गई वैज्ञानिकों की आखें
articles.summary: चीन के शिचांग सेंटर से उड़ान भरते ही 'लॉन्ग मार्च-3बी' रॉकेट पर आसमान से कड़कड़ाती बिजली आ गिरी, जिससे एक पल के लिए लगा कि बड़ा हादसा हो जाएगा. इस चीनी रॉकेट ने बिना डगमगाए उड़ते रहकर सबको हैरान कर दिया और अपने 'तियानलियान-2-06' डेटा रिले सैटेलाइट को एकदम सही ऑर्बिट में पहुंचा दिया. आसमान से गिरने वाली लाखों वोल्ट की बिजली से अक्सर रॉकेट के कंप्यूटर और नेविगेशन जल जाते हैं, पर चीन के इस रॉकेट पर क।

articles.title: मोदी सरकार के इस मंत्री का प्रधानमंत्री की सलाह पर इस्तीफा, राष्ट्रपति द्रोपदी मुर्मू ने किया
articles.summary: रेल राज्य मंत्री रवनीत सिंह बिट्टू ने अपना इस्तीफा दे दिया है। राष्ट्रपति द्रौपदी मुर्मू ने प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी की सलाह पर उनका इस्तीफा स्वीकार कर लिया है। प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के नेतृत्व वाली केंद्रीय कैबिनेट से रेल राज्य मंत्री का पद संभालने वाले रवनीत सिंह बिट्टू ने शुक्रवार (24 जुलाई, 2026) को अपना इस्तीफा दे दिया है. वहीं, राष्ट्रपति द्रौपदी मुर्मू ने प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी की सलाह पर रवनीत सिंह बिट्टू के केंद्रीय मंत्रिपरिषद से दिए इस्तीफे को तत्काल प्रभाव से स्वीकार कर लिया है.
